scenario: `s !~ /pattern/` is the negated regex dual per LREG.1.3 — the activation fires when the string does NOT match. A rule with `m.name !~ /^admin/` compiles cleanly.
rules_ds:
schema User scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    name: String mutable

rule non_admin:
    User u where u.name !~ /^admin/
->
    log info "non-admin"
